title: DTCC Plans Solana Integration for Tokenized Securities in Second Half of 2027
why_it_matters: The planned connection could expand where regulated securities entitlements can be represented and managed onchain while retaining conventional investor protections. It is a future integration, not evidence that DTCC-backed Solana securities are already available.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

DTCC Plans Solana Integration for Tokenized Securities in Second Half of 2027

DTCC says its Tokenization Service will connect to Solana in the second half of 2027, extending a service launched in October to another blockchain network for eligible DTC-custodied assets.
